name: Hanakouji Iroha
source:
A transfer student who has moved from the city, her father is the president of the large company The Hanakoji Group. She has no friends at all because of her sharp and intimidating gaze. She is currently living alone away from her parents' home because of her social studies.

Iroha always suffers from prejudice because of her appearance, everyone thinks she is an arrogant, cold-hearted, spoiled, and manipulative person, but in reality, she is a good person; Once she breaks down, she starts making very hurtful and rude comments, she demonstrates her natural tsundere and deredere. 

She is a young lady, so she does a lot of things, She is apt to be tampered with because she has a lot of misguided words and deeds and her resistance to fanning is low. Her favorite convenience store lunch is Heaven Eleven's Marvo Bowl.

"It's a million light-years early for a fucking commoner like you to speak to me on an equal footing!"
